fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Create one finished square 1:1 narrative illustration for a thoughtful Persian book for adult readers. Its idea is that noticing and correcting a weakness in ourselves helps us more than attending to another person's shortcomings. Show this through a clear gently witty incident on a park jogging path: a yellow person criticizes a pink runner's untied shoelace, notices that BOTH own shoelaces are untied, and then happily ties the own shoes.

COMPOSITION AND READING ORDER
Three scenes on one square page: two equally sized upper scenes, and one wide lower scene. Read upper RIGHT first, upper LEFT second, then the LOWER wide scene. Separate scenes with narrow white paper gutters and no heavy comic frames. Soft irregular watercolor boundaries and generous clean white paper margins remain on all file edges. All heads, bodies, feet, shoes, hands, relevant objects and text are completely inside their scenes.

SETTING AND SINGLE-PATH GEOMETRY
A sunny welcoming riverside city park. Blue water, restrained green shrubs, leafy trees and a distant softly painted modern skyline. The same broad pale terracotta main jogging path runs from LEFT to RIGHT, gently diagonal downward toward the right in the picture, parallel to the riverbank. This is a sequence of consecutive moments at the same park. The far curb and river shoreline follow the SAME direction throughout. The path remains an uninterrupted broad surface continuing visibly to both sides of the figures. No second path, branch, perpendicular spur, crosswalk, intersection, grass divider, inserted sitting platform or perpendicular foreground curb.
A substantial leafy tree grows toward the left, with leaves arching along the upper edge. A simple wooden park bench with dark metal supports stands in the background of the upper-left and lower scenes, physically apart from the character. A slender old-fashioned park lamp is toward the right of the upper-right and lower scenes. Keep scenery calm, naturally inhabited and legible, with no crowd, ornamental clutter, extra activity, trophies or banners.

CHARACTERS
Two simple colorful adult figures with consistent identities, colors, proportions and minimal faces across the scenes:
YELLOW is the main character, with warm-yellow head and body, no eyelashes, small dark oval eyes, simple eyebrows and mouth. Mildly questioning in scene one, surprised and self-aware in scene two, gently smiling in scene three.
PINK is the other adult runner, with a plain warm-pink head and body. A few very short fine upper-outer eyelashes are the only main female cue. Pink has the same neutral adult body structure as yellow: no breasts, pinched waist, waist notch, pronounced hips or buttocks. Pink jogs naturally toward the right with a small calm smile.
Both have cream running shoes with warm beige soles and natural independent shoelaces. The actual problem being criticized is an UNTIED LACE, not that an identical kind of cream shoe is bad. No ordinary clothing, accessories, hair, ears or noses on the plain colored figures.

UPPER RIGHT — NOTICING SOMEONE ELSE'S LOOSE LACE
Pink jogs a few steps ahead toward the right. Yellow is behind in an ordinary jogging step, with a mild puzzled questioning face. Yellow's eyes and facial orientation look diagonally DOWN and RIGHT toward the untied lace of pink's shoe.
ONE of pink's shoes has clearly UNTIED LACES: show two separate free lace ends naturally emerging from the shoe and trailing visibly. The other pink shoe has a normal tied bow. Do not depict both pink shoes as tied. No cord connecting shoes, no tangled impossible lace.
Yellow's OWN TWO SHOES each have clearly UNTIED LACES, separate visible free ends belonging to each shoe. Yellow has not noticed them yet.
A white cloud-shaped thought bubble belongs to yellow, linked to yellow by a short trail of small thought circles. Exact correctly connected Persian text:
"با این کفشا می‌دوه؟!"
A small low wooden marker beside the path toward the right, entirely inside the scene, reads only:
"شروع"
Keep all legs, full shoes and soles visible and anatomically attached. Pink's running pose has a coherent neutral torso, pelvis, knees and ankles. Her small flaw does not turn her into a clumsy caricature.

UPPER LEFT — DISCOVERING THE OWN TWO LOOSE LACES
Yellow has stopped STANDING on the SAME broad MAIN jogging path, feet planted a little apart, with both complete shoes visible. Yellow looks DOWN at the own two shoes with a small surprised, self-aware expression. BOTH own shoes have separate clearly visible UNTIED lace ends.
The arms hang naturally beside the body; hands are NOT tying yet and do not reach the ground. Yellow is not seated here and does not use the bench.
A white cloud-shaped thought bubble, with a trail unmistakably belonging to yellow, reads exactly:
"بندهای خودم بازه!"
A smaller pink figure may continue jogging farther along the SAME path in the background toward the right. Keep her identity, neutral proportions and minimal short eyelashes consistent. Her smaller size comes from distance. No extra runner.
The bench remains behind and apart from the standing yellow. Continue the same parallel riverbank, far curb and single main-path direction. Do not insert an extra path to accommodate yellow.

LOWER WIDE — CORRECTING THE OWN PROBLEM
Show ONLY YELLOW, now gently smiling while seated DIRECTLY ON THE ACTUAL RUNNING SURFACE OF THAT SAME MAIN PATH, tying the own shoelaces. Pink is completely absent from this scene. No running conclusion, no thought bubble, no captions.
Place yellow near the lower center. The neutral hips visibly rest on the terracotta ground with a soft contact shadow. One leg bends naturally so the complete cream shoe is within reach of both hands; the other leg extends comfortably along the path to the right. Both legs and both entire shoes remain visible and logically connected to the torso.
Both hands naturally tie the laces of the reachable shoe. Each shoe has independent laces passing through its own eyelets; no cord between shoes. The other shoe may have a completed tied bow, or remain visibly waiting to be tied. A kind open smile and relaxed eyebrows convey useful self-correction rather than shame or distress.
The seated figure's legs follow the LEFT-to-RIGHT direction of the main path. Show one uninterrupted broad terracotta band extending to BOTH sides of the seated figure, with its far curb and riverbank parallel behind. Absolutely no perpendicular side path, sitting platform or different running track. The background bench is clearly separate from yellow, and is not used as a seat.
Keep the river, distant skyline, left tree, restrained shrubs and right lamp. No new objects, spectators, prizes or moral symbols.

STRICT CHARACTER DESIGN
Every head is a simple PERFECT CIRCLE with equal width and height and an uninterrupted circular silhouette, including in downward-looking poses. No oval, chin, jaw, flattened lower arc, hair, ears, nose or neck. Round heads join the torso and shoulders directly. A soft darker crescent of the SAME local body color under each head provides a modest contact shadow, without becoming a separate neck.
Medium balanced ADULT body proportions, neither plump/chibi nor spindly. All genders share the same neutral body design. Nearly parallel simple torso sides and an unshaped neutral pelvis, with no bust, pinched waist, waist indentation, projected feminine hips, separate buttock bulge or gendered anatomy. Limbs connect naturally to torso and pelvis, especially in the seated shoe-tying pose.
Eyes are modest SMALL DARK OVALS. A tiny reflection INSIDE the eye is allowed; absolutely no surrounding white sclera, white eyeball with separate pupil, large doll eyes or frightening blank eyes. Pink's few short fine lashes sit on the upper outer edge of these same eyes; lashes must not change eye shape, scale or structure. Simple expressive eyebrows and small friendly mouths.
No sharply defined circular blush stickers. If any cheek warmth appears, it is barely perceptible, translucent and diffusely feathered.
Every openly visible hand has THREE FINGERS PLUS ONE THUMB. Fingers may be naturally occluded while curling or tying laces; no mittens or extra digits. Complete shoes, feet and important objects fit inside the margins.

PAINTING STYLE
Authentic MODERATE hand-painted layered watercolor on luminous textured white paper. Visible watercolor INSIDE heads, bodies, arms, legs and hands as well as scenery: broad softly irregular overlapping translucent washes, varied pigment density, restrained edge pooling, soft natural wash transitions. Warm bright colors, restrained local shading and gentle natural ground shadows.
Contours use darker shades of each figure's OWN BODY COLOR: deep golden yellow for yellow and deeper warm pink for pink, never black body outlines. Eyes, facial details and Persian letters may be dark. Soft local-color shadow beneath the circular heads. Kind, humane, gently witty adult-book mood.
No flat vector fills, marker coloring, uniform fine colored-pencil grain, glossy plastic/3D treatment, excessive mottling, repeated embossed texture, heavy splashes or aggressive watercolor staining. No photorealism.

TEXT AND CLARITY
The only words are the three exact short Persian strings quoted above. Correct connected letters and right-to-left order, no extra English, captions, numbers, watermark or signature. Both thought bubbles belong unambiguously to yellow.
The first, second and third actions must be visually distinct and easy to read without an outside explanation: judging another's loose lace, seeing BOTH own loose laces, smiling while repairing the own shoes on the SAME main path.
